title: fMRI Anticipation: vmPFC-like Falsification
description: Falsification-side coverage for the vmPFC anticipation predictions (EP-5). Tests P5b (vmPFC should NOT track primary interoceptive prediction error) and P5c (vmPFC effects should be valence-specific, not sensory-contrast-driven).

sub_predictions.claim: vmPFC does NOT significantly track primary interoceptive prediction error during experience phase
sub_predictions.key_measurement_equation: t_vmPFC_PE < 2.5 (corrected); if t > 2.5, P5b is falsified
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: vmPFC BOLD is not significantly correlated with primary interoceptive PE during the experience phase.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: vmPFC significantly tracks primary interoceptive PE (t > 2.5, corrected) — embodied-prioritization claim is rejected.

sub_predictions.claim: vmPFC effect is valence-specific rather than driven by sensory contrast
sub_predictions.key_measurement_equation: F_valence > F_sensory_contrast; if F_valence < 1.5, P5c is falsified
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: vmPFC BOLD varies significantly with valence (positive vs. negative anticipation) but not with sensory contrast alone.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: vmPFC effect is equivalent across valence conditions (F < 1.5) — valence specificity claim fails.

validation_notes: FP-14 stub — not yet implemented. Canonical EP-5 coverage: VP_22_FMRIAnticipationExperience.py. Superseded precursor: VP_15_FMRIAnticipationVmPFC.py.

inclusion_criteria: No history of cardiac or interoceptive disorders
exclusion_criteria: History of cardiac arrhythmia affecting HEP measurement

apparatus.execution_environment: APGI desktop application and local project runtime
apparatus.roi: vmPFC (medial prefrontal cortex, y > 0 mm in MNI space)

target.type: fMRI anticipation epoch (valenced cue → anticipatory period → somatic event)

trial_structure.response: Valence rating (pleasant/unpleasant) and interoceptive awareness rating
trial_structure.session_structure: Block design with interspersed anticipation and experience phases; counterbalanced valence

dependent_variables: vmPFC BOLD correlation with interoceptive prediction error (falsification target: should be non-significant)
vmPFC-posterior insula coupling under anticipation vs. experience
primary_hypothesis: vmPFC will NOT significantly track primary interoceptive prediction error during experience, and vmPFC effects will be valence-specific rather than sensory-contrast-driven — consistent with APGI's embodied anticipatory somatic marker account.
primary_analysis: GLM analysis of vmPFC BOLD with prediction error regressors; F-test for valence × phase interaction; vmPFC-posterior insula psychophysiological interaction (PPI) analysis.

power_analysis.based_on: fMRI vmPFC effect size estimate from somatic marker literature (d ≈ 0.5-0.6)

ethics.data_sharing: Anonymised fMRI BIDS dataset available upon request.

submission_blocking_issues: FP_14 is a stub — run_validation() returns not_implemented.
fMRI analysis pipeline (SPM/FSL GLM) not yet connected.
Valenced anticipation paradigm code not integrated.
caveats: FP-14 is a tertiary-tier extension of FP-09.
The canonical EP-5 implementation is VP-22, not VP-15.
